description: Remove native window opacity dead code from src/utils/window.js - the applyOpacity() function, the window:set-opacity IPC handler, the opacity branch in _applyStatePatch(), the opacity-related HARD_LIMITS entries, and the applyOpacity export. Also remove the onOpacityChanged and setOpacity methods from windowControls in src/utils/renderer.js, and remove the opacity-changed toast handler.
steps: In src/utils/window.js: Remove `opacityMax`, `opacityMin`, `opacityStepMin` from the HARD_LIMITS object (lines 23-25 area). Keep scaleMax, scaleMin, zoomMax, zoomMin, scaleStepMin, zoomStepMin.
In src/utils/window.js: Remove the entire `applyOpacity` function (around line 459-476 area) that calls win.setOpacity().
In src/utils/window.js: In setupWindowIpcHandlers(), remove the `ipcMain.handle('window:set-opacity', ...)` handler block.
In src/utils/window.js: In `_applyStatePatch()`, remove the `if (patch.opacity !== undefined)` block that calls win.setOpacity(). Keep the zoom and scale blocks.
In src/utils/window.js: Remove `applyOpacity` from the module.exports object.

In src/utils/window.js: Add a comment near the BrowserWindow creation options (after the `transparent: true` line) noting: '// Native opacity stays at 1.0; transparency is CSS-driven via --bg-app rgba values. Only stealth fade mode would use win.setOpacity().'
In src/utils/renderer.js: Remove the `setOpacity(v)` method from the windowControls object (the one that calls ipcRenderer.invoke('window:set-opacity', v)).
In src/utils/renderer.js: Remove the `onOpacityChanged(fn)` subscription method from windowControls.
In src/utils/renderer.js: Remove the `ipcRenderer.on('opacity-changed', ...)` toast handler that shows 'Window Opacity: X%'.
acceptance_criteria: No references to win.setOpacity() remain in window.js except possibly in comments
No 'window:set-opacity' IPC handler exists in window.js
No applyOpacity function or export exists in window.js
HARD_LIMITS no longer contains opacityMax, opacityMin, or opacityStepMin
_applyStatePatch no longer sets native window opacity
windowControls in renderer.js no longer has setOpacity or onOpacityChanged methods
No 'opacity-changed' listener remains in renderer.js toast section
verification: Run: node -e "require('./src/utils/window.js')" from /projects/sandbox/cd (will fail since electron not available in node - use grep verification instead)
Run: grep -n 'applyOpacity' src/utils/window.js (should return nothing or only comments)
findings: All 9 removal steps completed successfully. Grep verification confirms no remaining references to applyOpacity, window:set-opacity, opacityMax/Min/StepMin in window.js, and no setOpacity or opacity-changed in renderer.js. The only opacity-changed references remaining in renderer.js are font-opacity-changed and bg-opacity-changed events which belong to the CSS-driven opacity system.
